# CurioDrop AI 🧠💧

**A daily faceless YouTube Shorts channel — auto-generated by AI, published on autopilot.**

Niche: 60-second "did you know" curiosity drops (science, animals, mind-blowing facts) with cinematic AI visuals and a warm narrator voice.

Why this niche (2026 data):

- Faceless AI facts + animal/nature Shorts are the fastest-growing category on YouTube Shorts in 2026 ([miraflow.ai](https://miraflow.ai/blog/best-niches-youtube-shorts-2026-rpm-estimates), [easereel.com](https://easereel.com/blog/youtube-shorts-niche-analysis-2026))
- Script-driven, faceless, evergreen — perfect for full automation ([videoai.me](https://videoai.me/blog/profitable-ai-youtube-shorts-ideas-viral-2026))
- Kids/family-safe → higher watch time + broader ad inventory than motivation/horror
- Shorts RPM in facts/education range $0.05-$0.18 per 1K views ([fluxnote.io](https://fluxnote.io/guides/youtube-shorts-niche-selection-income-2026))

## Pipeline (fully automated)

```
 ┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────────┐
 │ 1. Topic     │ → │ 2. Script    │ → │ 3. Scene     │ → │ 4. Visuals   │ → │ 5. Voice +   │ → │ 6. YouTube   │
 │  picker      │   │  (ChatGPT)   │   │  breakdown   │   │  + motion    │   │  compose     │   │  upload      │
 │  (Supabase)  │   │              │   │  (ChatGPT)   │   │  (fal.ai)    │   │  (FFmpeg)    │   │  (Data API)  │
 └──────────────┘   └──────────────┘   └──────────────┘   └──────────────┘   └──────────────┘   └──────────────┘
```

All six steps run inside one Python job triggered by a daily cron on Railway.

## Cost per video (target)

| Item            | Provider              | Est. cost      |
| --------------- | --------------------- | -------------- |
| Script + scenes | OpenAI GPT-4o-mini    | ~$0.01         |
| 6-8 AI images   | fal.ai (Flux Schnell) | ~$0.05         |
| Image → motion  | fal.ai (Kling / Luma) | ~$0.35         |
| Voiceover       | ElevenLabs            | ~$0.10         |
| Compose         | FFmpeg (Railway)      | ~$0.00         |
| Upload          | YouTube Data API      | free (quota)   |
| **Total**       |                       | **~$0.50/day** |

## Repo layout

```
curio-drop-ai/
├── src/
│   ├── main.py                # entry point — runs the daily pipeline
│   ├── steps/
│   │   ├── topic.py           # picks today's topic from Supabase queue
│   │   ├── script.py          # ChatGPT script + scene breakdown
│   │   ├── visuals.py         # fal.ai images → motion clips
│   │   ├── voice.py           # ElevenLabs TTS + word-timings
│   │   ├── compose.py         # FFmpeg assembly (9:16, captions, music)
│   │   └── upload.py          # YouTube Data API v3 upload
│   ├── config.py              # env vars, constants
│   └── db.py                  # Supabase client + schema
├── prompts/
│   ├── topic_ideas.txt        # 200 seed prompts
│   ├── script_system.md       # persona: warm, curious narrator
│   └── scene_system.md        # visual director persona
├── assets/
│   ├── music/                 # royalty-free bed tracks
│   ├── captions/              # font (Inter Bold), sfx
│   └── outro.mp4              # 3s brand outro
├── docs/
│   ├── SETUP.md               # step-by-step setup for you
│   ├── BRAND.md               # color, font, tone-of-voice guide
│   └── CONTENT_STRATEGY.md    # posting cadence, thumbnails, SEO
├── railway.json               # cron schedule config
├── Dockerfile
├── requirements.txt
└── .env.example
```

See `docs/SETUP.md` for the 20-minute one-time setup.
